# The Ramnik Group

> A family business in Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, India, that has mined manganese
> for over a hundred years across four generations. It mines manganese ore at Ramrama,
> smelts that ore into ferro alloys at Sarandi, and generates its own power — first from
> rice husk, now from solar farms built on worked-out mine land.

Every figure below is on the site and is sourced from the company itself. Units are
metric. "t/yr" is tonnes per year.

## What the group sells

- **Silico manganese**, grades 60/15 to 70/15
- **Ferro manganese**, grades 70, 72 and 75
- **Low-carbon silico manganese**, to specification
- **Special grades**: low boron, low phosphorus, low sulphur
- **Manganese ore**, graded and sized

Material is crushed, sized and graded to the buyer's specification before packing and
dispatch. Buyers are Indian steel mills and export customers, including a long-term
agreement supplying a Japanese company through the year. Ore is also imported — from
South Africa, Gabon and Australia — and processed at Sarandi.

## Scale

- Mine capacity: 100,000 t/yr, expanding to 250,000 t/yr
- Alloy output: 50,000–60,000 t/yr, targeting 150,000 t/yr
- Five running furnaces, 34.5 MVA installed (22.5 MVA plus 12 MVA)
- Solar generation: 5 MW installed, 15–25 MW planned
- Around 20,000 trees planted

## Certification and recognition

- **ISO 9001:2015** quality management, certificate 250528012, held by Ramnik Power and
  Alloys Pvt. Ltd., valid to 27 May 2028. Certified scope covers mining, renewable
  energy, and the production, export and import of silico manganese, ferro manganese and
  manganese ore.
- **BIS** (Bureau of Indian Standards) — two product licences for the Sarandi works, held
  by Ramnik Power and Alloys Pvt. Ltd.: silico manganese to IS 1470:2013, licence
  CM/L-7400062009; ferro manganese to IS 1171:2011, licence CM/L-7400061908. Both renewed
  July 2026, valid to 20 August 2031.
- **Five-star rating** for the Ramrama manganese mine, 2017–18, from the Indian Bureau of
  Mines under the Ministry of Mines Sustainable Development framework.
- **Madhya Pradesh state environment award**, 2016–17, for pollution control and
  environmental protection in the working-mines category.
- **Mine Safety Week 2019**, Directorate of Mines Safety, Western Zone, Nagpur.
- **Outstanding Achievement Award 2014**, Federation of Madhya Pradesh Chambers of
  Commerce and Industry.

## Entities and locations

- **Ramnik Power and Alloys Pvt. Ltd.** — power and ferro alloys. Registered at
  Plot No. 1–11, Industrial Area, Waraseoni–Katangi Road, Sarandi, Balaghat 481331,
  Madhya Pradesh, India.
- **A. P. Trivedi & Sons** — manganese mining, at Ramrama, Balaghat district.

Directors: Nischal Trivedi and Harsh Trivedi.
